quote: Julian didn't just ship features — he redesigned the data model so billing, tenants, and audit logs finally made sense. The Prisma schema is still the most readable part of our stack.
author: Mira Ellison

quote: We handed over a tangled Express monolith. He carved out a clean API, containerized local dev, and left CI that actually catches regressions. That's a software engineer, not a ticket-closer.
author: Theo Maren

quote: Frontend, API routes, and Postgres landed as one system. Performance stayed under budget after launch, and the next hire could onboard from the README alone.
author: Sable Quinn
